entries.name: AY-3-8910 PSG
entries.description: General Instruments programmable sound generator: three tone channels, a noise generator, an envelope generator and two 8-bit I/O ports, run through 16 registers.
entries.behaviour: A write to the address port latches the register number in bits 0 to 3, but only when bits 4 to 7 are zero; otherwise the chip goes inactive, ignoring data writes and answering data reads with 0xFF. Reset leaves it inactive, so write an address first.

handlers.address_w: register select: bits 0 to 3 latch the register when bits 4 to 7 are zero
handlers.address_data_w: combined: offset bit 0 clear selects the register, set writes data
handlers.data_address_w: combined: offset bit 0 clear writes data, set selects the register
handlers.write_bc1_bc2: combined bus form: offset bits 0 and 1 are BC1 and BC2; 0 and 3 select the register, 2 writes data, 1 does nothing
handlers.reset_w: reset line: clears registers 0x00 to 0x0D, the register latch and the active state
handlers.set_pin26_low_w: pin 26 low: halves the clock input, on the types with a clock select (ym2149, ym3439)
handlers.set_pin26_high_w: pin 26 high: restores the normal clock input
